title: Spectrum Live this weekend
content: If you live anywhere near the middle of the USA, please come on out to Kansas City, Missouri this weekend, May 18-20 forSpectrum Fantastic Art Live,a huge festival of fantasy and science fiction artwork.I will have several original paintings exhibitedfor sale, along with drawings, signed art prints, portfolios, and prints, and other goodies.This is a great chance to talk informally withall of the artists, get them to sign your books or sketchbooks, or just look at lots of imaginative artwork. The entry fee is very low, only $20 for a day. Hope to see you there if you can make it.-----Spectrum Fantastic Art Live
